blocks.text: You can copy an existing Forwarding Profile and customize the profile to fit your needs, instead of having to configure each setting in a new profile.
Follow these steps to copy a Zscaler Client Connector Forwarding Profile:
You cannot copy the default profile.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Forwarding Profile.
Click the Copy icon next to the profile you want to copy.
In the Copy Forwarding Profile window:
Enter a new name in the Profile Name field.

blocks.text: Your copied profile appears at the bottom of the Forwarding Profile table.
You can copy a maximum of 10 profiles at the same time.
